inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Training Requirements - Original Training Certification Card or Letter in each Employee's personnel record: During the inspection I could not verify employee training due to the employee training certificates not being present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Original Training Certification Card or Letter in each Employee's personnel record (26 TAC §744.1331(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation does not have a current fire inspection. The inspection expired on 1/16/2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §744.3501(a))

occurrences.finding: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely
occurrences.violation_type_title: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely (26 TAC §744.3803(c))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services: The center's policy on how they accommodate children with special care needs is not included in the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Unassigned Epinephrine Auto-Injectors (26 TAC §744.501(25))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation, Sheltering/Lock-Down Procedures: The operation's Emergency Preparedness Plan in their operational policies does not include the identification and physical address of a relocation site nor does it include the procedures for reunifying children with their parents in the event of relocation to an off site address.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation, Sheltering/Lock-Down Procedures (26 TAC §744.3553(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training-6 Hours of Required Topics: The site director and five caregivers are missing discipline training on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training-6 Hours of Required Topics (26 TAC §744.1309(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: During a previous inspection, the operation?s fire inspection was not current. The updated fire inspection was requested but has not been submitted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §744.3501(a))

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: During an inspection, two employees were missing their education credentials on file for review. I followed up with the operation and one employees? diploma was provided however, the other was not.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §744.1105(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): One out of six employee files evaluated is missing a notarized affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (26 TAC §744.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: Two out of six employees files evaluated are missing education credentials on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §744.1105(2))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation's fire inspection is not current. The last inspection was conducted on 12/18/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §744.3501(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Current Driver's License: One caregiver who transports children had an expired driver's license on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Orientation Completed (26 TAC §744.901(10))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines: During a follow up inspection, the director and five employees had not completed the hands on and written CPR certification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines (26 TAC §744.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Director Present During Operating Hours: The director was not present during unannounced visits on 9/5/2024, 10/8/2024, and 11/05/2024. In addition, information was received that the director is not consistently at the operation during operating hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Present During Operating Hours (26 TAC §744.1011)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: During a follow up inspection, the person in charge did not have access to employee attendance records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §744.801(1))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines: The director and five employees completed online CPR certification however, there is no documentation showing the hands on and written training was completed in person.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines (26 TAC §744.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training-Required Topics in Health and Safety: Five caregivers are missing training in the following topics:    -Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training-Required Topics in Health and Safety (26 TAC §744.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended: Based on evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support a five year old child was left on the van for approximately 90 minutes unattended.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended (26 TAC §744.3805(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Account for All Children: Based on evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support a caregiver failed to conduct name to face checks to account for all children when transitioning out of the van into the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Account for All Children (26 TAC §744.3805(3))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Based on evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support the operation failed to report that a child was left on a van unattended for approximately 90 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §744.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected. or Exploited: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS Investigation. Based on evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support the allegation of neglectful supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected. or Exploited (26 TAC §744.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: The children's records were not available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §744.801(1))

occurrences.finding: Access to Personnel Records: The operation's personnel files were not available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Access to Personnel Records (26 TAC §744.909)

occurrences.finding: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children: Children's medication was kept in a backpack in an unlocked cabinet that was accessible to children.    Note: Corrected when the children's medication was moved into a locked cabinet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §744.2657(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Two caregivers who did not have background checks were present at the operation and had access to children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: Two transportation vehicles used to transport children did not have fire extinguishers.    Note: Corrected when a caregiver bought two fire extinguishers to place in the vehicles.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §744.3817(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date: Two children's medication containers were missing the date it was brought to the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §744.2655(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation does not have a current sanitation inspection as it expired on 9/2/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §744.2501(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: Five transportation vehicles were inspected during the inspection.     -Two vehicles were missing first aid kits.  -Two vehicle's first aid kits were missing scissors, cotton  balls, and a thermometer.       Note: Corrected when new first aid kits with all of the required items were added to each vehicle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §744.3817(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation does not have a current fire inspection as it expired on 7/23/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §744.3501(a))
